$comment: Release history for three.ws Forge, newest first. scripts/release-manifest.mjs copies the current version's notes into the published release.json that https://three.ws/forge-desktop and the in-app updater show. Add an entry here before building a new version.

notes.title: three.ws Forge, the desktop 3D studio
notes.summary: Generate 3D models from images and prompts with local open-source generators or the three.ws Forge cloud, chain mesh processing in a node workflow editor, browse the CC0 object library, and publish straight to your three.ws account. Built on Modly by Lightning Pixel (MIT).
